_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate (only 7% of recent windows move ±2pts) plus F&G/momentum/30d flat keep the score inside the Complacency band through the event window.
next_move.brains_agree: partial split — both read near-term supply/sell pressure, but analyst explicitly holds the rung while narrative emphasizes distribution; neither calls a rung jump
next_move.confirmed_if: fear_greed stays 45-55, 30d change near flat, and no reclaim/hold above $82,000 through Friday OPEX
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC reclaims and holds above $82,000 with ETF flows turning up, or fear_greed exits 39-55 and forces the score out of the Complacency band
